about: One row per input of REQUIREMENTS_2026-10-20 §6.1. Byte-identical in designer-portal and documentation-portal, on the web (frontend/e2e/fixtures) and on Android (app/src/test/resources). services: what the mocked card resolve / record lookup answers for each portal (found, replaced, peer, refused, offline; found, missing, missingTitled, offline). expect: the outcome per portal, and the exact title where the copy is shared.
